companies.name: Patrimonio Autónomo Estrategias Inmobiliarias (Pei)
companies.reason: Pei, a real estate investment vehicle, has coverage in the 7 days before October 27, 2026 from several sources. The Bolsa de Valores de Colombia (bvc.com.co) published a page dated 2026/10/26 presenting Pei as the first real estate investment vehicle to trade on the variable-income market. Pei announced in October 2026 that LarrainVial would become its second liquidity provider for its participation securities (pei.com.co, reported by Valora Analitik). Its price was reported on October 26 and 27, 2026 by Investing.com and Bloomberg Línea. Pei is listed and tradeable on the BVC under PEI. Its Terranum portfolio acquisition, covered by Valora Analitik, La República and Forbes Colombia, dates from September 22, 2026, so it falls outside this 7-day window and is not used as the trending basis.
